## Project Overview

A Telegram bot was developed to recommend board games based on user interests. The bot is implemented in R and uses a content-based approach: recommendations are generated based on the similarity of games by key features. There is also a command to receive a random game from the dataset.

[View the full report with code and analysis](../reports/boardgame-bot-report.html)

## Data and Methods

- Data from GitHub: ~24 features, filtered and processed for 1000+ games  
- K-means clustering (12 clusters) and Gower distance used for similarity calculation  
- Recommendations based on a game difference matrix  
- Categories were merged and encoded (83 → 14)  
- Telegram bot supports `/recommend`, `/random`, `/help`, and `/start` commands

## Key Takeaways

- The bot provides relevant recommendations (expert evaluation)  
- Most popular games are strategic/card games (Cluster 2)  
- Longest duration games are war-themed (Cluster 9)  
- Interface tested, functionality confirmed  
- Hosting and UX improvements are needed for scaling
